next_experiment.action: seed a small verified probe before expanding difficulty

tasks.stage_goal: small variation of a task the system already almost solves
tasks.title: Warm start variation for generalization
tasks.objective: Restate and solve a close variant of the known gap: bootstrap curriculum from self-observed uncertainty. Keep only one missing slot active: fresh_gap_source.
tasks.acceptance: success score >= 0.70 and no new anchor failure

tasks.stage_goal: change one premise or missing slot while preserving the domain
tasks.title: Controlled variation for generalization
tasks.objective: Change one premise or missing slot from the original gap while preserving domain generalization. Missing slots: fresh_gap_source.
tasks.acceptance: the system must explain which premise changed and preserve performance >= level 1 - 0.05

tasks.stage_goal: execute the active experiment that should close the gap
tasks.title: Active experiment for generalization
tasks.objective: Run the proposed active experiment: seed a small verified probe before expanding difficulty.
tasks.acceptance: task must produce an auditable score

tasks.stage_goal: transfer the skill to an adjacent but unseen domain
tasks.title: Zero-shot bridge from generalization to generalization_zero_shot_bridge
tasks.objective: Transfer the learned procedure from generalization into unseen domain generalization_zero_shot_bridge without using stored examples from that domain.
tasks.acceptance: zero-shot score >= 0.60 or a precise new active investigation is opened

tasks.stage_goal: force a new domain with explicit external or sandbox validation
tasks.title: Novel-domain stress task for generalization_zero_shot_bridge
tasks.objective: Create a novel task in generalization_zero_shot_bridge, require external or sandbox validation, and compare expected vs observed outcome.
tasks.acceptance: the task must record surprise, validation evidence, and a pass/fail score
